question:
Which of the following terms is NOT related with cricket?

I. Runs

II. Dribbling
solution:
The correct answer is__** Only II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dribbling** is not related to** cricket.**
 
• **Dribbling is a technique **used in sports like football, hockey, and basketball, but not in cricket.
 
• It is the **act of moving the ball on the ground with gentle strokes** of the feet while moving in a specific direction.
 
• In cricket, players score runs by hitting the ball and running between wickets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
